dog.description_text:
If you're looking for a playful, fun-loving pup who will keep you smiling, Stella is your girl! ❤️
⚖️ 7.5 pounds of puppy sweetness!
🐶 Potential Shepherd/Lab Mix
Stella has one motto in life — PLAY, PLAY, PLAY! 🐾 She absolutely LOVES being outdoors when the weather is nice, running around, exploring, and enjoying everything life has to offer!
And did we mention she LOVES to eat? 😂❤️
This sweet girl is working hard on potty training! She's already figured out that she needs to go to the door — she just hasn't quite mastered waiting for someone to open it! She's still a baby, and she's learning every day.
🏡 Stella is ready to find her forever family! A family who will give her plenty of playtime, patience, outdoor adventures, and a lifetime of love!
dog.name: Stella
